title: Jonathan Ross 'horrified' by Walliams allegations and Brand conviction
description: The TV presenter says he was once "friendly" with David Walliams and Russell Brand, but was "genuinely unaware" of their conduct.

title: 'I felt like I was being manipulated': Woman alleges Walliams groomed her as a teenager
description: Lilly Creightmore, who has alleged Walliams "groomed" her as a teenager, has told BBC Newsnight that she was "angry" at his behaviour.

title: Thousands of schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
description: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public. It is not known if the incidents are linked.

title: Scottish DJ, 32, confirmed as victim of Krakow shooting
description: The man, who is understood to be James Thomas Campbell from Prestwick, died when a lone gunman opened fire in central Krakow on Saturday.

title: Spain sees widespread disruption in first general strike for 14 years
description: Protests are also expected in the biggest cities less than three weeks before Spaniards vote in parliamentary elections.

title: Watch: UK falls silent to mark Armistice Day
description: People from Belfast to Cardiff, London to Edinburgh held the two-minute silence to mark the end of World War One and to remember those who have died in conflicts.

title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive
description: Thousands of messages seen by BBC show how a Chinese official sought details of sensitive political matters.

title: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough
description: Talks in Abu Dhabi centred around Europe's security framework, with US envoys due to meet Putin and Zelensky on Thursday.

title: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated after alleged Iranian threats
description: Bessent is now one of several Trump administration officials to live on military bases due to safety concerns.
